findings.passage: The right to vote is foundational to citizenship in a democracy.  Voter fraud is extremely rare, yet our state legislature continues to pass laws that burden voters and restrict access to the ballot.  I oppose any effort to suppress voting because democracy only works when everyone participates.
findings.note: Platform page on her campaign site, under the heading VOTING RIGHTS. States her view on voting laws in general terms. Does not name photo ID, citizenship proof or any bill.
